mentions.name: kle-ng
mentions.description: A keyboard layout editor (kle-ng) being extended with bezier curve support and Western duplex support for keyboard fabrication, aiming to get ergo support and PCB generation working for large keyboard builds.
mentions.problem: Getting ergo support and PCB generation working for non-trivially large keyboard builds.
mentions.source_excerpt: Adding bezier curve support, adding Western duplex support, to kle-ng for keyboard fab. Wanted to build a BIG keyboard, but get ergo support and the pcb gen working for non trivially large builds
mentions.author: cdaringe
